predecessors.name: British Mandate for Palestine
predecessors.text: the Jewish state of the partition plan (56% of Mandatory Palestine) and the ground won in 1948

ledger.x: 14 May 1948: Israel declares independence.
15 May 1948: Egypt invades.
15 May 1948: the Arab Legion enters the West Bank.
1948: Syria holds ground west of the international border.
24 February 1949: Israel and Egypt sign the armistice at Rhodes.
10 March 1949: Israel reaches the Gulf of Aqaba.
3 April 1949: Israel and Jordan sign the armistice.
April 1949: Wadi Ara and the Little Triangle pass to Israel.
April 1949: Israel gives up land in the southern Hebron hills in exchange for Wadi Ara (same sentence as the gain above).
20 July 1949: Israel and Syria sign the armistice.
29 October 1956: Israel invades the Sinai.
November 1956: the fighting stops.
November 1956: Israel holds the Sinai and Gaza.
March 1957: Israel leaves the Sinai and Gaza.
5 June 1967: the Six-Day War opens on the Sinai and Gaza front.
June 1967: the West Bank front.
June 1967: the Golan front.
8-9 June 1967: the ceasefires.
8 June 1967: Jordan accepts the ceasefire (same sentence).
9 June 1967: Syria accepts the ceasefire (same sentence).
June 1967: Israel occupies the whole Sinai Peninsula.
6 June 1967: Israel takes the Gaza Strip.
June 1967: Israel occupies the West Bank.
9-10 June 1967: Israel takes the Golan Heights from Syria ('the Israel Defense Forces captured the Golan Heights on 9-10 June'), 1,070 km2 for the Heights proper.
27 June 1967: Israel extends its law to East Jerusalem.
6 October 1973: Egypt crosses the Suez Canal.
6 October 1973: Syria attacks on the Golan.
25 October 1973: the war ends.
25 October 1973: on the Golan front 'Israeli forces held 500 km2 of the Syrian Bashan region of the Golan Heights' at the ceasefire.
1974: Quneitra returns to Syrian civil administration.
14 December 1981: the Golan Heights Law.
14 December 1981: Israel annexes the Golan Heights.
1982: Israel invades Lebanon.
1982: the Sinai is Egypt's again.
1985: Israel pulls back from most of Lebanon.
1985: the South Lebanon Security Belt.
31 July 1988: Jordan gives up the West Bank.
31 July 1988: the West Bank is now claimed by the PLO ('Jordan renounced its claims to the West Bank for the PLO').
24 May 2000: Israel leaves Lebanon.
12 September 2005: Israel ends its occupation of Gaza.
2006: Israel re-enters southern Lebanon.
1 October 2006: the last Israeli troops leave this occupation ('until the 1 October 2006').
27 October 2023: Israel's ground invasion of Gaza.
1 October 2024: Israel invades southern Lebanon.
December 2024: Israel occupies the Syrian buffer zone.

wars.name: 1948 Arab-Israeli War
wars.outcome: Israel survived and 'the 1949 armistice left Israel controlling more territory than had been allocated to it under the UN partition plan'; Jordan kept the West Bank and East Jerusalem, Egypt the Gaza Strip; armistices with Egypt (24 February), Lebanon (23…

wars.name: Suez Crisis
wars.outcome: Israel overran the Sinai and Gaza (29 October to early November 1956) and held them until March 1957; the Canal was closed from October 1956 to March 1957.

wars.name: Six-Day War
wars.outcome: Israel took the Sinai, Gaza, the West Bank with East Jerusalem and the Golan Heights, 'a total of 70,000 km2'; ceasefires 8 June (Egypt, Jordan) and 9 June (Syria), signed 11 June 1967.

wars.name: Yom Kippur War
wars.outcome: Ceasefire 25 October 1973 with Egyptian bridgeheads (1,200 km2) east and an Israeli salient (1,600 km2) west of the Suez Canal, Israel holding 500 km2 of the Syrian Bashan; no border change at the time, the 1974 disengagements and the 1979 treaty followed.

wars.name: 1982 Lebanon War
wars.outcome: Israel invaded 'to destroy the PLO bases', withdrew from parts of the occupied area between 1983 and 1985 and kept the South Lebanon Security Belt until 24 May 2000.

wars.name: 2006 Lebanon War
wars.outcome: Israel occupied parts of southern Lebanon again until 1 October 2006.

wars.name: Gaza war
wars.outcome: Begun by the 7 October 2023 attacks from Gaza; Israel invaded on 27 October 2023 and 'has occupied portions of the strip ever since'.

wars.name: 2024 Israeli invasion of Lebanon
wars.outcome: Invaded 1 October 2024, withdrew from most regions in February 2025 and kept five outposts.

certainty.note: The front lines moved all year; no armistice line existed before 1949.
The 1949 armistice lines (the Green Line), the 1979 Egypt treaty and the 1994 Jordan treaty are line-defined.
